f_01M0TK8P7DPQZBYG5DF3Y9T6WD.subject: restoration_package_pricing
f_01M0TK8P7DPQZBYG5DF3Y9T6WD.content: Tanny Spa Acquisitions offers three hot tub restoration packages priced as flat all-in packages: Base/Essential $4,100 (vs $5,325 individually), Premium $6,300 (vs $10,552), and Platinum $8,400 (vs $16,032), each including warranty and round-trip transport.

f_01M0TK8P7DZ09VSDQCP26ZAZKH.subject: restoration_package_warranty
f_01M0TK8P7DZ09VSDQCP26ZAZKH.content: Base and Premium restoration packages carry a 90-day full-coverage warranty; Platinum carries a 1-year full-coverage warranty.

f_01M0TK8P7D4706FKPDMM2WJFBD.subject: pump_replacement_pricing
f_01M0TK8P7D4706FKPDMM2WJFBD.content: Additional pump replacement is $650 per pump; the Essential/Base package rebuilds existing pumps, Premium replaces one pump (extra pumps at $650 each), and Platinum replaces every pump at no upcharge.

f_01M0TK8P7DBTPRK27A4KPBZSCE.subject: restoration_agreement_payment_terms
f_01M0TK8P7DBTPRK27A4KPBZSCE.content: Restoration service payment is invoiced and processed through QuickBooks, with a signed Restoration Service Agreement accompanying each invoice; a deposit is due at signing and the balance is due before the restored spa is returned.

f_01M0TK8P7DBJZ15BTBMVV6T42V.subject: restoration_transport_access_terms
f_01M0TK8P7DBJZ15BTBMVV6T42V.content: Round-trip spa transport is included with a standard on-property move of up to two hours; non-standard access (craning, fence removal, stair carries) is quoted separately before scheduling.

f_01M0TK8P7DR74BXN9584P7XNAC.subject: package_tier_naming_discrepancy
f_01M0TK8P7DR74BXN9584P7XNAC.content: The entry-level restoration package is labeled 'BASE' in Restoration Packages.pdf but 'ESSENTIAL' in Restoration_Service_Agreement.pdf, both referring to the same $4,100 tier.

f_01M0TK8P7E90QWPGBWX5CV2CSB.subject: mislabeled_unrelated_document
f_01M0TK8P7E90QWPGBWX5CV2CSB.content: The file 'Jacuzzi Temperature Sensor Resistance Chart.gif.pdf' does not contain a hot tub temperature sensor chart; its content is an unrelated numerical data table bearing a faint '...aCars.com' watermark, suggesting mislabeling or accidental upload.
